about.storyTitle: It all started with a simple idea
about.storyText1: Travio Ghana was built on a simple idea: make it easy for travellers to discover and book authentic experiences in Ghana, while giving local operators the platform they deserve.
about.storyText2: Every experience on our platform is reviewed and curated by our team to meet quality, safety and authenticity standards — so travellers can book with confidence.
about.calloutHeading: We connect travellers with hand-picked experiences across Ghana, from cultural tours to adventure activities.
about.calloutBody: Our mission is to make discovering those moments effortless — whether you're a first-time visitor or a seasoned traveller looking for something new.
about.badgeText: Quality, safety and authenticity checked before every experience goes live.
about.value1Text: Every tour on Travio Ghana is reviewed and curated to meet our quality, safety and authenticity standards.
about.value2Text: We work directly with local operators and guides who know their destinations best.
about.value3Text: Our suppliers meet clear safety and quality standards, and we vet every new experience before it goes live.
about.value4Text: The price you see is the price you pay. No hidden fees, no surprises.
about.value5Text: Our support team is here before, during and after your trip to help with anything you need.

faq.needHelpText: Can't find your answer? Our team is happy to help.
faq.q1: How do I book a tour?
faq.a1: Browse our tours, select your preferred date and time, choose the number of travelers, and complete the checkout. You'll receive a confirmation email with all the details.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept major credit and debit cards, mobile money, and other local payment methods depending on your region.
faq.q3: Are prices per person or per group?
faq.a3: It depends on the tour. Most tours show per-person pricing, but some experiences are priced per group. Check the pricing section on the tour page for details.
faq.a4: Most bookings are confirmed instantly. Some tours require manual confirmation by the operator, in which case you'll receive a confirmation within 24 hours.
faq.a5: Yes, most tours offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts. Non-refundable tours are clearly marked. Check the cancellation policy on the tour page.
faq.q6: What happens if the operator cancels my tour?
faq.a6: If the operator cancels, you'll receive a full refund or the option to rebook another date. You'll be notified by email as soon as possible.
faq.a7: Refunds are typically processed within 5-10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.
faq.a8: The refund amount is based on the actual price you paid, including any applicable discounts.
faq.a9: Check the 'Meeting and pickup' section on the tour page. Tours that include pickup will list the available pickup areas and meeting points.
faq.q10: When will I receive my pickup details?
faq.a10: Pickup details are confirmed after booking. You'll receive the exact pickup location and time via email before your tour.
faq.q11: What if I miss my pickup?
faq.a11: Contact the tour operator directly using the phone number in your booking confirmation. They may be able to arrange an alternative meeting point.
faq.a12: Enter your promo code during checkout. The discount will be applied to your total if the code is valid for the selected tour and date.
faq.q13: Why did the price change after I viewed a tour?
faq.a13: Prices may change based on demand, availability, or special offers. We recommend booking when you see a price you're happy with.
faq.a14: You can reach us via email, phone, WhatsApp, or live chat. Visit our Contact Us page for all the details.
faq.a15: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Sunday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (GMT).
